review_cost.rationale: One genuine round of changes: fix the search-debounce race and stop swallowing ready() rejections; the rest are nits I'd mention but not block on.

findings.issue: The 150ms search debounce fires after the user has navigated to another page (renderHome ignores ctx.isCurrent), and applyFilters then calls history.replaceState('/?q=…'), overwriting the URL of the page the user is now on and breaking back/forward.
findings.suggestion: Capture ctx.isCurrent and bail in the timeout (or clearTimeout in a teardown the router calls); at minimum check isCurrent() before touching history.

findings.issue: `await result.ready?.catch(() => {})` silently discards every error from the moves section; a failed move fetch leaves #moves permanently empty with no user-visible or logged error.
findings.suggestion: catch, console.error, and render a small inline error in the moves section; the ctx.isCurrent pattern for updating it already exists.

findings.issue: fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res) has no stream error handling; an error between stat and read (or a client abort) becomes an unhandled 'error' event that can take down the server.
findings.suggestion: stream.on('error', …) → send a 500, and destroy the stream on res 'close'.

findings.issue: The API_BASE_URL injection into the meta attribute escapes only '<'; a double quote in the env var would break out of the content attribute.
findings.suggestion: Also replace '"' with '"' (or escape with the full HTML-attribute set) before splicing into index.html.

findings.issue: Route patterns are duplicated between the production server (for 404 status) and the client router with no shared source of truth; they can silently drift when a page is added.
findings.suggestion: Export the route regex table from one shared module (server.mjs can import a plain .ts-compiled or .mjs route list) or generate the server list from a single routes constant.

findings.issue: Local helper typeNames(Type[]) shares its name with api.typeNames(Iterable<string>) but has different semantics, inviting the wrong import; the type-label-map idea now exists in three shapes across the codebase.
findings.suggestion: Rename to typeLabelMap and consider consolidating on one helper in format.ts/api.ts.

findings.issue: moveTables fetches every distinct move of a version group in one unbounded Promise.all (100+ parallel requests on first view of a modern game's table).
findings.suggestion: Fine against the local cached API; if the API ever goes remote, chunk the fetches or build rows from a list endpoint.

findings.issue: When ?page= exceeds the number of pages, the displayed page is clamped (Math.min) but the URL still says the out-of-range page, so a reload or shared link re-clamps differently after data changes.
findings.suggestion: replaceState the normalized URL (page clamped, page=1 omitted) as part of update().

summary: A genuinely well-crafted vanilla-Vite app: clean layering (api/dom/format/components/pages), naming and structure that mirror the spec, careful accessibility and race-awareness in the router. The main thing I'd ask for before merge is honoring the existing isCurrent pattern in the home page's search debounce, which currently can rewrite the history entry of a page the user has already navigated to, plus surfacing errors that the moves section currently swallows. Everything else is nits I'd approve quickly.
